settings.heading: What is the difference between a personal and workplace breathalyser?
settings.text: Personal devices prioritise portability and straightforward self-testing. Workplace devices may support higher test volumes, stored records, printing, GPS, identity verification or software connectivity. Choose according to the testing process - not only the sensor specification.

settings.heading: Are Andatech breathalysers certified to Australian Standards?
settings.text: Andatech's breathalyser range includes devices certified to Australian Standard AS 3547. Confirm the applicable certification and version on the individual product page before purchase.

settings.heading: Do portable and wall-mounted breathalysers require calibration?
settings.text: Yes. Recurring calibration helps maintain reliable readings. The correct interval can depend on the model and testing environment, so follow the product instructions and service schedule.

settings.heading: Which devices can connect to Andalink?
settings.text: Selected portable and wall-mounted devices offer Andalink compatibility. If reporting, multi-site visibility or centralised evidence is important, make that requirement part of the product-selection conversation.

settings.heading: What if we need more than equipment?
settings.text: If you also need policy, training, calibration planning, reporting or ongoing governance, start with an Andatech solutions specialist rather than choosing a device in isolation.
